# langsmith_gateway_policy (Resource)

Manages a LangSmith Gateway Policy

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_gateway_policy" "monthly_spend_cap" {
  name        = "monthly-spend-cap"
  description = "Block requests once workspace monthly spend exceeds the limit."
  action      = "block"

  config = {
    spend_cap = {
      window    = "monthly"
      limit_usd = 100
    }
  }

  subject_matchers = [{
    key   = "workspace_id"
    value = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  }]
}

resource "langsmith_gateway_policy" "burst_and_sustained_rate_limit" {
  name        = "burst-and-sustained-rate-limit"
  description = "Block requests once a API key exceeds request or token limits"
  action      = "block"

  config = {
    rate_limit = {
      version = 1
      limits = [
        { # optional: caps requests within a minute
          metric = "requests"
          window = "minute"
          value  = 25
        },
        { # optional: caps request volume over an hour
          metric = "requests"
          window = "hour"
          value  = 1000
        },
        { # optional: caps tokens within a minute
          metric = "tokens"
          window = "minute"
          value  = 50000
        },
        { # optional: caps token volume over an hour
          metric = "tokens"
          window = "hour"
          value  = 2000000
        },
      ]
    }
  }

  subject_matchers = [{
    key   = "api_key_id"
    value = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  }]
}

resource "langsmith_gateway_policy" "pii_and_secrets_guard" {
  name        = "pii-and-secrets-guard"
  description = "Block requests that contain detected PII or secrets."
  action      = "block"

  config = {
    guard = {
      version = 1
      detect = {
        pii     = { enabled = true }
        secrets = true
      }
      timeout_seconds = 3
      timeout_action  = "allow"
    }
  }

  subject_matchers = [{
    key   = "workspace_id"
    value = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  }]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) The action to perform when the policy is violated
- `config` (Attributes) The config of the gateway policy. Exactly one typed child is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `name` (String) The name of the gateway policy
- `subject_matchers` (Attributes List) The subject matchers of the gateway policy (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subject_matchers))

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the gateway policy
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the gateway policy is enabled
- `priority` (Number) The priority of the gateway policy

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp of when the gateway policy was created
- `created_by` (String) The ID of the user who created the gateway policy
- `id` (String) The ID of the gateway policy
- `is_system_generated` (Boolean, Deprecated) Whether the gateway policy is system generated
- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the LangSmith organization to which the gateway policy belongs
- `parent_policy_id` (String) The ID of the parent policy
- `policy_type` (String) The type of the gateway policy, inferred from which config block is set.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp of when the gateway policy was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--subject_matchers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subject_matchers`

Required:

- `key` (String) Subject kind. Built-in: organization_id, workspace_id, user_id, or api_key_id.

For a custom X-Gateway-* header, drop the "X-Gateway-" prefix and lowercase the rest, replacing any non [a-z0-9_] char with _ (e.g. header "X-Gateway-My-Internal-Team" matches as key "my_internal_team").
- `value` (String) Subject id for that kind (e.g. workspace UUID), or the custom header value. Matched exactly (case-sensitive) against the request value. Must be empty string "" for default_* policy types
